subtopicOpeners.text: Pehle kuch basic important notes:
Dono funds ka benchmark same hai:
Ab baat karte hai AUM ki.
Toh, kaun hai in dono funds ke fund managers?
Ab dekhte hai, inn funds ke investment philosophy ke baare mein.
Ab hum in donom funds ke portfolio ke baare mein jaante hain.
Ab baat karte hai market cap allocation ki.
Average market cap ki baat karein toh, Invesco India Large & Mid Cap Fund ka average market cap hai ₹97,433 Crore, jabki Motilal Oswal Large and Midcap Fund ka average market cap hai ₹77,294 Crore.
Valuation ki baat karein toh, Invesco ka Portfolio P/E Ratio Motilal Oswal ka Portfolio P/E Ratio se zyada hai aur Portfolio P/B ratio comparitively kam hai.

Portfolio turnover ki baat karein toh, Invesco India Large & Mid Cap Fund ka reported turnover hai 61.82%, jabki Motilal Oswal Large and Midcap Fund ka reported turnover hai 42.35%, dono hi March 31, 2025 tak ke data ke hisaab se.
Ab, Sirf portfolio composition dekhkar equity funds ko judge karna kaafi nahi hota. Chaliye ab risk aur risk-adjusted returns ki baat karte hai.
Pehla metric hai Standard Deviation, jo yeh batata hai ki fund ke returns kitna fluctuate karte hai apne average return ke comparison mein.
Ab baat karte hai Beta ki. Beta measure karta hai ki fund benchmark ke comparison mein kitna volatile hai. Beta 1 se zyada matlab fund benchmark se zyada volatile hai.
Alpha ki baat karein toh, Invesco India Large & Mid Cap Fund ka Alpha hai 8.11, jabki iski category ka average sirf 0.62 hai.
Ab baat karte hai Sharpe Ratio ki, jo har extra unit of risk ke liye fund ne kitna extra return diya, yeh batata hai.
Ab chaliye dekhte hai Upside aur Downside Capture Ratio ko.
Upside Capture Ratio batata hai ki jab market upar jaata hai, fund apne benchmark ke comparison mein kaisa perform karta hai. 100 se zyada matlab fund ne benchmark se behtar perform kiya.
Downside Capture Ratio batata hai ki jab market girta hai, fund us fall mein kitna neeche jaata hai. 100 se kam matlab fund benchmark se kam gira, jo achhi baat hai.
Ab baat karte hai Maximum Drawdown ki, jo yeh dikhata hai ki fund apne peak se kitna neeche gira sabse bura phase mein.
Ab baat karte hai returns ki, yaani fund ki actual performance ki.
Ab 3-year performance dekhte hain.
Ab 5-year returns ki baat karein.
Ab return consistency check karne ke liye in funds ke discrete returns par nazar daalte hain.
Ab baat karte hai expense ratio ki, yaani fund ko manage karne ke liye har saal li jaane wali fee.
Conclusion
